verses.raw: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and give up what remains [due to you] of interest, if you should be believers.
verses.text: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and give up what remains [due to you] of interest, if you should be believers.

verses.raw: And if you do not, then be informed of a war [against you] from Allāh and His Messenger. But if you repent, you may have your principal - [thus] you do no wrong, nor are you wronged.
verses.text: And if you do not, then be informed of a war [against you] from Allāh and His Messenger. But if you repent, you may have your principal - [thus] you do no wrong, nor are you wronged.
